analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Rapamycin (sirolimus) is an FDA-approved immunosuppressant with a boxed warning, approved for kidney-transplant rejection prevention and LAM. It extends lifespan in mice, but no human trial has tested lifespan; the human aging trials are small or short, used surrogate measures, and gave mixed results, and the largest trials tested related drugs rather than rapamycin itself.
